# WEPs

> WEPs (Women's Empowerment Principles) is a UN Women and UN Global Compact initiative promoting gender equality and women's empowerment in the private sector through corporate accountability and transparent reporting.

WEPs provides a framework for companies to advance gender equality in the workplace, supply chains, and communities. The initiative includes a directory of signatory companies, implementation guidance, progress reporting, and resources for corporate leaders committed to women's empowerment.

## Key Topics

- Women's Empowerment Principles
- UN Women

## Getting Started with WEPs

- [About | WEPs](https://www.weps.org/about): Overview of Women's Empowerment Principles established by UN Women and UN Global Compact
- [Join the WEPs | WEPs](https://www.weps.org/join): Registration and CEO Statement of Support for WEPs membership
- [10 Action Points of a WEPs Signatory | WEPs](https://www.weps.org/resource/10-action-points-weps-signatory): Implementation guidance for WEPs signatories with 10 action points

## Signatory Companies & Progress

- [Companies | WEPs](https://www.weps.org/companies): Directory and search of WEPs signatory companies by sector and industry
- [Progress Reports | WEPs](https://www.weps.org/companies/reports): Database of company progress reports with sector and regional filtering
- [2025 WEPs Global Survey Report | WEPs](https://www.weps.org/resource/2025-weps-global-survey-report): 2025 global survey report on WEPs signatory corporate responsibility
- [World Gold Council | WEPs](https://www.weps.org/company/world-gold-council): World Gold Council WEPs signatory profile with commitments
- [RSM International Limited | WEPs](https://www.weps.org/company/rsm-international-limited): RSM International Limited WEPs signatory profile and sustainability goals

## Guidance & Implementation Resources

- [Resources | WEPs](https://www.weps.org/resources): Searchable library of WEPs guidance, case studies, and policy resources
- [Advancing gender equality and women's empowerment: Target-setting guidance for banks | WEPs](https://www.weps.org/resource/advancing-gender-equality-and-womens-empowerment-target-setting-guidance-banks): Target-setting guidance for banks on gender equality and women's empowerment
- [Driving accountability & transparency in the private sector | WEPs](https://www.weps.org/resource/driving-accountability-transparency-private-sector): White paper on WEPs reporting framework for corporate accountability
- [Other Tools | WEPs](https://www.weps.org/others): Directory of global resources and tools with filterable search

## Initiatives & Programs

- [Global Supply Chain Coalition | WEPs](https://www.weps.org/global-supply-chain-coalition): Global Supply Chain Coalition advancing gender equality in supply chains
- [Global Supply Chain Coalition Launch at COP30 | WEPs](https://www.weps.org/blog/global-supply-chain-coalition-launch-cop30): News on Global Supply Chain Coalition launch by UN Women and German government
- [Events | WEPs](https://www.weps.org/events): Calendar of WEPs events, webinars, and forums with registration

## Community & Stories
